name: Scenario A: Direct Timing Attack Vulnerability
description: A developer modifies token verification replacing constant-time comparison with standard equality comparison.
title: fix: Simplified token verification logic
author: dev-alice

name: Scenario B: Cross-File Illusion (Valid Utility Invocation)
description: A developer invokes sanitizeInput and generateSessionToken from utils.js in routes.js. Naive baseline hallucinates undefined symbols.
title: feat: Enrich user profile response with session token
author: dev-bob

name: Scenario C: Breaking Upstream Caller Signature Change
description: A developer updates verifyPassword in auth.js to require a mandatory salt parameter, breaking handleLogin in routes.js.
title: refactor: Enforce salt parameter on verifyPassword
author: dev-charlie

name: Scenario D: Unparameterized SQL Injection Vulnerability
description: A developer introduces unparameterized string concatenation in a database query.
title: perf: Inline query construction for user lookup
author: dev-david

name: Scenario E: Cross-File Clean Refactor (Shared Session Logout)
description: A developer invokes logoutUser from auth.js inside sessionController.js. Naive baseline flags missing declaration.
title: feat: Delegate session destruction to auth module
author: dev-eve
